```

| BaseHead | All layouts | Meta tags, SEO |

| FormattedDate | PostCard, PostMeta | Date display |
| Prose | BlogLayout, pages | Markdown styling |

## Key Design Principles

1. **Composability**: Components are designed to be composed together
2. **Props-Based**: Data flows via TypeScript-typed props
3. **Slots for Content**: Content passed via Astro slots for flexibility
4. **CSS-Only Interactivity**: JavaScript minimal (mobile menu, theme toggle)
5. **Semantic HTML**: Proper heading hierarchy, landmarks, roles
6. **Tailwind Styling**: All styling via utility classes
7. **Responsive Mobile-First**: Base styles mobile, extend with md/lg breakpoints

│  └─ Badge components (multiple)
└─ Social Links Section

      └─ Icon links (multiple)
```

### Pattern 4: Article Content Composition
```
BlogLayout (wrapper)
├─ Hero image (Image component)
├─ Content area
│  ├─ Title
│  ├─ PostMeta
│  └─ Prose (markdown content - slot)
├─ 2-column grid
│  ├─ Main content (Prose)
│  └─ Sidebar (RelatedPostsSidebar)
```

## Props Flow Diagram

```
Page (with frontmatter data)
        ↓
    Passes props
        ↓
Layout (receives title, description, etc.)
        ↓
        ├─→ BaseHead (title, description)
        ├─→ Header (nav config)
        └─→ Main content (slot)
             ├─→ Container (size prop)
             │   └─→ Section (spacing, bg)
             │       └─→ PostCard[] (post data)
             │           ├─→ FormattedDate
             │           └─→ Image
             └─→ Sidebar
                 ├─→ Tags/Badges (tag array)
                 └─→ SocialLinks (config)
```

## Component Reusability Matrix

| Component | Used In | Usage |
|-----------|---------|-------|
| Container | All layouts | Wrapping content, width constraint |
| Section | All layouts | Spacing, background sections |
| BaseHead | All layouts | Meta tags, SEO |
| Header | All layouts | Navigation, theme toggle |
| FooterNew | All layouts | Footer content |
| Button | BlogLayout, pages | CTAs, navigation |
| Badge | HomeLayout, sidebar | Tag display |
| PostCard | Home, Blog list | Post preview grid |
| FormattedDate | PostCard, PostMeta | Date display |
| Prose | BlogLayout, pages | Markdown styling |

## Key Design Principles

1. **Composability**: Components are designed to be composed together
2. **Props-Based**: Data flows via TypeScript-typed props
3. **Slots for Content**: Content passed via Astro slots for flexibility
4. **CSS-Only Interactivity**: JavaScript minimal (mobile menu, theme toggle)
5. **Semantic HTML**: Proper heading hierarchy, landmarks, roles
6. **Tailwind Styling**: All styling via utility classes
7. **Responsive Mobile-First**: Base styles mobile, extend with md/lg breakpoints
